scenarios.title: Connect a trusted local Codex runtime
plannedActions: Connect and start Codex with an owned signed runtime and an isolated pairing identity.
expectedOutcomes: Connection readiness, process ownership, and protocol replies come from the real signed companion.
scenarios.restriction: The current native lane uses an isolated loopback provider. Real helper and Keychain behavior require a separately isolated Mac identity with the verified signed companion. Companion-owned code needs its own instrumented capture.

scenarios.title: Fetch an image through WebRTC from another Mac
plannedActions: Open an owned shared project on both peers and use Preview Fetch image to transfer the original.
expectedOutcomes: The receiving Mac verifies the original byte digest and attaches the image to the intended project.
scenarios.restriction: The current signed CLI reports cloudIsolation.peerTransport disabled. WKWebView ICE networking needs an isolated WebRTC lane.

scenarios.title: Finish legacy GitHub sign-in in the browser
plannedActions: Open Continue with GitHub and complete an authorized browser login for a dedicated account.
expectedOutcomes: The app validates the original login request before publishing the authenticated account.
scenarios.restriction: The current signed CLI reports cloudIsolation.oauth disabled and the production ASWebAuthenticationSession starts outside the CLI transport policy.

scenarios.title: Check and prepare a signed app update
plannedActions: From Check for Updates, use an isolated signed release fixture and exercise the real updater callbacks.
expectedOutcomes: The signed updater reports its state and verifies saved projects before asking to relaunch.
scenarios.restriction: The retained automation app lacks a valid update signing key. The available CLI action reaches the check sheet; its signed Sparkle path needs a disposable signed update environment.

scenarios.title: Select a Codex model in runtime Settings
plannedActions: Add scoped CLI selection to the existing model menu, then select a different model while connected to the synthetic provider.
expectedOutcomes: The existing model action changes the selected runtime model.

scenarios.title: Join and leave a team using invitation links
plannedActions: Open Teams, submit several invalid and valid link formats through Join, then leave through its native confirmation.
expectedOutcomes: Rejected links preserve membership; each legitimate invite creates only the synthetic viewer membership and leave removes it.

scenarios.title: Trace a fresh local launch
plannedActions: Launch Scriv in a fresh owned workspace with --startup-trace.
expectedOutcomes: The app publishes ordered local startup stages with bounded public fields and opens the intact sample project.

scenarios.title: Inspect a picture whose original is unavailable
plannedActions: Open Details for the existing picture in the fixture with missing local bytes.
expectedOutcomes: The inspector shows the exact version, missing local copy, fetch and replacement choices. Closing keeps the saved project and playback position.

scenarios.title: Load the native accessibility bridge for protected alerts
plannedActions: Inspect and activate a real native alias alert with a verified supported control route.
expectedOutcomes: The app dispatches the exact native control through its verified accessibility adapter.
scenarios.restriction: The character-alias fallback was denied by Library Validation. Keep this app path on hold until a supported verified route exists.

scenarios.title: Invalidate an open generation brief when its source changes
plannedActions: Apply a project change through an owned production sync route while the generation brief stays open.
expectedOutcomes: The stale request is cleared, its tabs are disabled, and the brief can still be closed.
scenarios.restriction: The verified CLI import route rejects an already presented controller. This condition needs an owned sync fixture that changes the source while the review remains mounted.

scenarios.title: Refuse a native export when the saved project changed
plannedActions: Open Settings and activate Export project with a different valid snapshot in the owned project.
expectedOutcomes: The app reports the export refusal and preserves both the loaded project and the different saved snapshot.

scenarios.title: Hand the verified package to the native project export picker
plannedActions: Export a current saved project through the real Settings button and observe the owned staging and picker.
expectedOutcomes: The picker receives a complete copy of the live project, including its package members and history.
scenarios.restriction: The Catalyst app stages the export in its sandbox temporary directory. An inherited host temporary directory did not redirect it. This path needs a verified owned CLI observation of the picker and stage.

scenarios.title: Report rate limiting for a native email code request
plannedActions: Request a code from the real sign-in sheet after the owned Worker has accepted its address quota.
expectedOutcomes: The sign-in sheet displays the Worker rate limit, disables retry during cooldown and preserves the local script.

scenarios.title: Recover native sign-in after an incorrect code and remote revocation
plannedActions: Submit an incorrect fixture code, sign in in a fresh owned app session and refresh after a real remote revocation.
expectedOutcomes: The app rejects the incorrect code, accepts a fresh challenge and returns the unchanged saved script to local-only state after revocation.

scenarios.title: Inspect the signed-in Codex Account menu
plannedActions: Open the real Codex Account control after connecting to an idle signed-in loopback fixture.
expectedOutcomes: Scriv presents the account menu with Refresh account, Sign out of ChatGPT and Cancel and preserves the saved projects.
